skill_group_precedence.group_membership_rule: For a skill in an alternatives group, evaluate the group collectively using minimum_options_to_learn. Individual member importance labels do not make every alternative mandatory; meeting the group minimum satisfies that group requirement. Additional known members can count as evidence but must not be reported as missing mandatory skills.
skill_group_precedence.non_alternative_rule: For skills outside alternatives groups, retain the individual importance classification. Optional groups do not create mandatory skill gaps. Conditional groups are evaluated only when their stated condition applies.
skill_group_precedence.compatible_stack_rule: A compatible_stack group describes a technically valid combination, not a requirement to learn that stack. For Backend Developer, satisfy the required technology_stack_requirement by learning at least one listed stack as a unit. Do not infer compatibility by taking the cross-product of separate language and framework alternatives.
skill_group_precedence.complementary_rule: Complementary groups describe distinct capabilities that can be used together; they are not interchangeable choices.
